question: Which of the following cities is NOT one of the four cities from India selected by the World Economic Forum in November 2020 for pioneering a new global policy roadmap for the smart cities developed by the G20 Global Smart Cities Alliance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandigarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The four Indian cities **Indore, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Faridabad** were selected by the World Economic Forum in November 2020 for pioneering a new Global policy roadmap for the smart cities developed by G20 Global Smart Cities Alliance.
 
• The world economic forum had **selected 36 cities out of 22 countries and 6 continents.**
 
• Other cities selected by the world economic forum are **London, Toronto, Moscow, Dubai, Brasilia, Melbourne, etc.**
 
• These cities were chosen because they are** rapidly adopting new technologies in the pandemic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF):** 

 
 
• **Formation: **24 January 1971
 
• **Founder: **Klaus Schwab
 
• **Headquarters: **Geneva, Switzerland
 
• The theme of WEF 2020 was** Stakeholders for a Cohesive and Sustainable World.**
